name: Brick Machine
author: elzekool
description:
Things are falling down! And it is your task to guide those falling bricks by dragging platforms and portals into the right position.
Do this as quickly as possible to gain the maximum points. Oh and also choose your platforms wisely, nothing comes for free.
You score points by being quick, by keeping your lives and by only using the platforms you need.
The name "Brick Machine" comes from Rube Goldberg machine where once set in motion, you don't control the machine anymore
